text:
Elaine H: Quick ask for cost modeling — we need definitive behavior from our hardware/cloud partners on marketplace SKU crediting when spot is evicted and Reserved fallback is used. Specifically: do we receive a credit, is usage charged to reserved pool, and what's the eviction grace / pro-rate rule? Can partners provide CSV rows for their top SKUs with exact policy columns?

Mike F: From finance: please capture (1) credit type (negative line item vs billing offset), (2) credit timing (days to appear), (3) pro-rate granularity (minute/hour), and (4) whether reserved pools absorb evicted workloads. We need this to model month-end accruals.

Oliver P: FWIW from last sync: vendors verbally said reserved fallback -> billed to reserved if reserved capacity still active; spot eviction -> credits issued only for unfulfilled spot minutes and show as negative line items next invoice. Need written confirmation. Also unclear on eviction grace (5m?) and whether short-lived preemptions (<30s) are ignored.

Ria S: For our cost pipeline we really need event-level signals (webhook or CSV) for eviction events so we can reconcile tokenized usage to credits. If partners cannot provide event feeds, we need deterministic rules to implement: e.g., credit = min(remaining_minutes/60 * spot_rate, invoice_line). Proposed CSV schema below.

Elaine H: Example CSV we want partners to return (please confirm exact column names and types):

```
sku,commit_type,eviction_grace_secs,credit_policy,credit_timing_days,pro_rate_unit,notes
zenith-gpu-a100-80gb,reserved+spot,300,negative_line_item,14,minute,credit applies only to unbilled minutes; reserved fallback billed if reserved capacity available
```

Mike F: +1. Also ask partners to provide sample rows for their top 10 SKUs and an example invoice with the negative line item so finance can validate parsing.

Oliver P: ops-bot, can we open a tracker for partner confirmations and set an EOD Friday follow-up?

ops-bot: Ticket created: PRT-3214 — "Partner SKU crediting & eviction policy confirmations". Assignee: Partnerships Ops. Due: 2025-02-14. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/PRT-3214

Ria S: Two more asks: (1) clarify whether credits are net vs gross (tax handling), (2) confirm whether commit break fees offset credits or are billed separately. If reserved window >30 days we expect pro-rated refunds rather than immediate credits — call that out.

Elaine H: Thanks — I'll ping our partner contact and paste their CSV response here. If no written confirmation by EOD Friday I'll escalate to Ben. :thumbsup:

Mike F: Thanks Elaine. One more: please request their standard SLA/legal text for eviction notice windows (we need to map to our fallback SLOs).

Oliver P: Will stand by to convert their CSV into our cost model mapping once we get it.

Ria S: I'll add a reconciliation job to detect mismatch between billed credits and expected credits (rule-based) once we have sample rows.
